explanation: From main: Merging main keeps its App-rendering tests awaiting preloadAppViews(), its lazyView and originHealth coverage, and its compareDownloads regression for blank compare-set group means on unmeasured genes. This branch adds the Circadian tab tests (per-arm comparison, notes, controls, table, trace, strip, full-gene exports and the workbook worker protocol) plus the exportProvenance, csv, rhythmScanIdentity and sortableHeaderA11y updates; the circadian tests render CircadianTab directly, so they need no view preload. From the cross-study listing: crossStudyListing.test.ts pins the listing in tables: lead and rest per mode and order, counts, dataset rules, flat rows, missing and non-finite keys, stable ties on subsets and no mutation. Report, preview, index and condition-card fixtures now build rows through geneRow / pathwayRow so no fixture contradicts its tier. searchPage adds a lowest-p versus lowest-q case, pathwayReportResults an FDR-mode survivors-first case, and crossDatasetSummary.test.ts goes with summarizeGroup.
